test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

I don’t like to work with people who are not **__flexible__**.
solution:
The correct answer is "Rigid."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The word "flexible" means capable of bending easily without breaking. (बिना टूटे आसानी से झुकने में सक्षम)

 
 
• Example:* The wire has to be **flexible**__ enough to go around corners of the room.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "flexible" is "rigid."
 
• The word "rigid" means unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible. (झुकने या आकार से बाहर होने में असमर्थ; लचीला नहीं)
 __
 
• Example:* The sculpture was a **rigid**__ steel and concrete structure.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Capable: **having the ability, fitness, or quality necessary to do or achieve a specified thing. (किसी निर्दिष्ट चीज़ को करने या हासिल करने के लिए आवश्यक क्षमता, फिटनेस या गुणवत्ता होना)
 
• **Malleable: **(of a metal or other material) able to be hammered or pressed into shape without breaking or cracking. ((किसी धातु या अन्य सामग्री का) बिना टूटे या टूटे हुए आकार में हथौड़ा मारने या दबाने में सक्षम)
 
• **Open-ended: **having no predetermined limit or boundary. (जिसकी कोई पूर्व निर्धारित सीमा न हो)
